visual.general_description: Composite clinical timeline graphic on a white background with six columns headed by printed month and year labels. Each column has a thin vertical line, a text box or label, and a pair of axial chest cross-section images at the bottom. Two horizontal green bars span the middle of the figure.
visual.detailed_description: Six printed month-and-year date labels run across the top, one per column (values not transcribed here because they are burned-in record dates). A thin vertical line descends from each date label; no arrows or arrowheads are drawn. First column: plain text reading "left upper lobe nodule" and "wedge resection", then a purple-pink microscopy image captioned "Hematoxylin eosin stain 400×", then the plain text "adenocarcinoma" and "pT2aN0M0". Second column: a gray box reading "mediastinal and supraclavicular lymph nodes metastasis". Third column: a pale blue box reading "NGS of the surgically resected archived tumor tissue · KIF5B-RET fusion". Fourth column: a rounded box reading "pulmonary cryptococosis" above a paler purple microscopy image captioned "Periodic acid Schiff 400×". Fifth column: a rounded box reading "staphylococcal aureus pneumonia". Sixth column: a gray box reading "pleural metastasis and pericardial metastasis". Two horizontal bars run across the middle: a lighter green bar printed "alectinib 600mg twice daily" with "PFS 8m", followed by a darker green bar printed "pralsetinib 200-300mg once daily" with "PFS 9m". Red letters printed under the bars read "PD" under the third column, "SD" under the fourth, "SD" under the fifth and "PD" under the sixth. Bottom: each of the six columns has two stacked grayscale axial chest cross-section images. In the first column the lower image is a pink-red tinted panel with a red horizontal line, a green vertical line and a bright red spot where they cross. In the second and third columns the upper images show dark lung fields with a bright central mediastinum; the lower images use a darker grayscale window in which the lungs are black and enlarged soft-tissue density is visible in the central chest. In the fourth column the images show patchy and nodular opacities in the lung fields. In the fifth column the images show a thick-walled cavity-like lucency in one lung. In the sixth column the images show a large homogeneous gray-white region occupying much of the central chest with surrounding lung opacities. No scanner text, patient name, ID, laterality marker or exam date stamp is visible inside any of the image panels.

evidence.quote: Herein, we report an 81-year-old NSCLC patient with KIF5B-RET fusion
he was diagnosed as pulmonary cryptococcosis
the follow-up chest CT scan revealed multiple nodules and patchy shadows
The sputum culture revealed methicillin-sensitive staphylococcus aureus (MSSA)
multiple nodules and patchy shadows on the right middle and right lower lobes
hypertension as the main adverse effect

pixel_observations: Six printed month-and-year date labels (values not transcribed) head six columns joined to their content by thin vertical lines without arrowheads.
Printed first-column text: "left upper lobe nodule", "wedge resection", "adenocarcinoma", "pT2aN0M0", with a microscopy image captioned "Hematoxylin eosin stain 400×".

Printed text boxes: "mediastinal and supraclavicular lymph nodes metastasis", "NGS of the surgically resected archived tumor tissue · KIF5B-RET fusion", "pulmonary cryptococosis", "staphylococcal aureus pneumonia", "pleural metastasis and pericardial metastasis".
A microscopy image captioned "Periodic acid Schiff 400×" is printed under the "pulmonary cryptococosis" box.
Two green bars are printed with "alectinib 600mg twice daily" and "PFS 8m" (lighter bar) and "pralsetinib 200-300mg once daily" and "PFS 9m" (darker bar).
Red text "PD", "SD", "SD", "PD" is printed under the third to sixth columns respectively.
Six pairs of stacked grayscale axial chest images; the first column lower image is a pink-red tinted panel with a red line, a green line and a red spot.

No scanner text, name, ID, laterality marker or exam date stamp is visible inside the image panels; the month-and-year labels are timeline headings drawn on the graphic above the columns, not stamps inside the images.

clinical_significance.statement: The caption presents the figure as the timeline of the index patient clinical course; the case text cites Figure 1 for the pathology, progression, cryptococcal biopsy, lung abscess and effusion findings.

evidence.quote: the chest CT scan revealed pericardial effusion and bilateral pleural effusions ( Figure 1 )

limitations: Printed values (dates, doses, PFS, PD/SD labels, TNM text) are pixel content only and are not clinical facts of this record.
The first-column printed text "left upper lobe nodule" differs from the article text, which places the incidental nodule in the right upper lobe; the discrepancy is not resolved here.
The "NGS ... KIF5B-RET fusion" box is printed under the third date label, whereas the case text describes the sequencing before alectinib began; the figure placement is not used to date the test.
The pink-red tinted first-column panel is printed under the first date label while the text dates the PET-CT to October 2020; which examination each image belongs to is not established.
Image laterality is not printed on the chest images; no side is stated.
